entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi Sarah. I'm just so sad. I bought a VeloBand Cadence Sensor a little while ago, and it's just not working at all.

I'm really sorry to hear that you're having trouble. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's definitely a fault. It just won't sync with my phone, no matter what I do. I think the sensor itself is broken. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I saved up for this... I was really counting on it.
I understand your frustration, and I appreciate your loyalty. It's disappointing when a new device doesn't perform as expected. So it sounds like you believe the item is defective?
Yes, I'm sure it is. I just feel so let down. I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out for me.

Of course. Let me just pull up your order information and check our policy for you. Can you confirm the email address on the account?... Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand 32 days ago.
Oh no... is that too long? I was so busy, I didn't get a chance to call sooner. I was hoping I could still do something.

Not a problem at all. I've just checked our policy, and we allow for returns of any items within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 32, you're well within that window. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now.
Really? Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so, so much, Sarah.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just package the sensor back in its original box and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
